claims: Tyson Fury defeated Arslanbek Makhmudov by unanimous decision with scores of 120-108, 120-108, 119-109.
The fight took place on April 11, 2026.
The fight took place at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London.
The fight was Tyson Fury's return to the ring after a 16-month break.
Tyson Fury had previous losses to Oleksandr Usyk.
Conor Benn won against Regis Prograis by unanimous decision.
Conor Benn vs Regis Prograis was on the same Netflix fight card as Tyson Fury vs Arslanbek Makhmudov.
The fight was available globally on Netflix
